html:
The Hang Tien Cave Tour 1 Day is an unforgettable adventure for nature and cave enthusiasts. Known as “Fairy Cave,” Hang Tien is the largest cave in the Tu Lan cave system, featuring spectacular limestone formations, rimstone pools, and high chambers that showcase Vietnam’s wild jungle beauty.

This one-day tour is perfect for travelers who want to explore a pristine jungle environment, experience a river cave, and enjoy adventure without staying overnight in the wild. Suitable for both seasoned adventurers and first-time explorers, Hang Tien Cave offers a unique blend of trekking, caving, and natural swimming opportunities.

TOUR ITINERARY

07:00 – 07:30 – Pick up from your hotel in Phong Nha. Drive 1.5 hours to Tan Hoa office, passing through lush jungle, fields, and the historic Da Deo pass. Safety briefing by your experienced guide during the journey.

09:00 – Arrive at Tan Hoa office, sign the Release Form, and collect equipment including jungle boots, lights, helmets, and water bottles. Extra luggage can be stored safely.

09:30 – Drive to the trailhead and start trekking into the forest at 10:00. Hike over a hill and rocky terrain to reach Hang Tien Cave.

12:00 – 12:30 – Enjoy a BBQ lunch near the cave entrance with fresh pork, spring rolls, and vegetarian options available.

12:30 – 16:00 – Explore Hang Tien Cave. Marvel at rimstone pools, lush ferns, high chambers, skylights, and spectacular rock formations. Take time to relax, swim in the natural jungle pool, and capture photos.

16:00 – 18:00 – Trek back to the drop-off point, take a shower at Tan Hoa office, and transfer back to Phong Nha.

19:30 – 20:00 – Arrive at your hotel in Phong Nha, completing the tour.

TOUR INFORMATION

  • Operating Period: Mid-November – Mid-September (closed in October)

  • Duration: 1 day

  • Adventure Level: Moderate, 13.5 km, suitable for physically active guests

  • Group Size: 2 – 8 pax (small-group tour)

  • Minimum Age: 16 years old

  • Start Time: 07:00 – 07:30 from any local hotel in Phong Nha

  • End Time: 19:30 – 20:00 at any local hotel in Phong Nha

  • Price: 140 USD per person

INCLUSIONS

  • Private car transfers

  • Jungle lunch

  • Camping and trekking tools

  • English-speaking local tour guide

  • Bottled water

EXCLUSIONS

  • Personal expenses

  • Tips

CHILD POLICY

  • Only guests aged 16 years and above can join this tour
outline: Day 1: DISCOVERY PHONG NHA – HANG TIEN CAVE TOUR
